target.title: fix(agents): contain async progress callback failures
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where an embedded-agent presentation or telemetry callback could reject after the subscription discarded its Promise, allowing a non-essential progress callback to become an unhandled Node rejection and terminate the Gateway.

## Why This Change Was Made

All untracked embedded-subscription callback families now use one shared best-effort wrapper: assistant stream, partial reply, tool result, reasoning stream, assistant-message boundaries, lifecycle events, and compaction events. It catches synchronous throws and attaches a rejection handler without changing awaited or tracked delivery paths such as block replies.

## User Impact

An agent run remains alive when a UI, telemetry, or progress subscriber fails. The failure is logged with its callback category instead of escalating into a process-level unhandled rejection.

## Evidence

- Added regression coverage for rejected assistant-progress callbacks and lifecycle-start callbacks; the existing block-reply rejection cases remain covered.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.block-reply-rejections.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.compaction.test.ts` passed: 60 tests in 3 files.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- CI passed the full Node validation matrix on the initial PR head; the current focused follow-up is queued for the same checks.
- AI-assisted; two repository autoreview passes completed with no accepted findings.
